step_by_step_reasoning: The visual architecture shows a user-facing interaction flow driven by AWS Lex. An Alexa device (UserConsumerAlexaGoogleHome) and a web/bot interface (UserConsumerWebMobile) interact with Lex. Lex routes requests through API Gateway to Elasticsearch (OpenSearch) for searching health content. Lambda processes these search results and returns content back to the web/bot interface. Additional services shown include Polly, S3, Athena, and Kinesis.
